title: iPhone 17 Pro is Vulnerable to Scratching, But Not Where You Might Think
summary: Durability testing found the sharp anodised edges of the camera plateau scuff easily, while the rest of the aluminium body resisted scratches well.

title: Apple responds to iPhone 17 Pro scratch and durability concerns
summary: Apple said marks on in-store demo units were material transferred from worn MagSafe stands and can be cleaned off, and that the aluminium camera plateau can show small abrasions over time.

title: iPhone 17 Pro Max durability test: Scratchgate is Apple's fault
summary: JerryRigEverything's durability test blamed the camera-plateau scuffing on design: the plateau's edges have no chamfer or radius, so the anodised coating adheres poorly there.

findings.subject: apple-iphone-17-pro-max
findings.text: The camera plateau's sharp, unchamfered edges are the weak point for scuffs. The flat body and back resisted scratches well.

title: iPhone 17 aces durability test
summary: The base iPhone 17 came through JerryRigEverything's scratch, burn and bend tests well, helped by its Ceramic Shield 2 front glass.

title: OPPO Find X9 Series Launches Globally, Redefining Flagship Experience with 200MP Hasselblad Telephoto, 7000+mAh Battery, Top-Tier Performance, and ColorOS 16
summary: OPPO's press release announcing the global launch of the Find X9 series with a 200 MP Hasselblad telephoto and 7,000+ mAh batteries.

title: OnePlus 15 with 6.78″ 1.5K 165Hz AMOLED display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, 7300mAh battery announced
summary: China launch of the OnePlus 15 from CNY 3,999, with a 165 Hz display, 7,300 mAh battery and 120 W wired charging.

title: realme GT8 and GT8 Pro with 6.79″ 2K 144Hz OLED display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, up to 200MP telephoto camera, 7000mAh battery announced
summary: China launch of the realme GT 8 Pro from CNY 3,999, with a RICOH GR camera system and 200 MP periscope.

title: Honor Magic 8 Pro will reportedly have battery downgraded by 13% in Europe
summary: Reported ahead of the European launch: the EU Magic8 Pro ships with a smaller battery than other markets. GSMArena's EU test unit had 6,270 mAh against 7,100 mAh globally.

title: Honor Magic 8 Pro Goes Global: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, 200MP Camera and More
summary: The HONOR Magic8 Pro's international rollout begins in Malaysia.

title: RedMagic 11 Pro brings its liquid cooling to the global stage
summary: Global availability from $669 / €669, on sale from 18 November, in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and the Middle East.

title: Google Pixel 10 will soon get a GPU driver update
summary: After reports of stutter in demanding games linked to an outdated GPU driver, Google confirmed that driver updates for the Pixel 10 series were coming.

title: Pixel 10 Gets A Hidden Performance Upgrade — What The New Graphics Driver Really Delivers
summary: Hands-on testing of the updated Tensor G5 GPU driver reported measurable gains in some games, though Pixel 10 gaming performance still trails rival flagships.

title: iQOO 15 with 6.85″ 2K LTPO 144Hz OLED display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, 7000mAh battery launched in India
summary: India launch from ₹72,999 for 12 GB / 256 GB.

title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra Is Now Official; Retails From RM6,799
summary: Launch-day Malaysian pricing: from RM6,799 for the models on sale then. The 12 GB / 256 GB model, listed as coming soon at launch, is RM5,999 (see the device's prices).

title: Samsung confirms the Galaxy S26 Ultra price starts at $1,299
summary: US pricing starts at $1,299.99 for 256 GB, unchanged from the S25 Ultra.

title: Exynos 2600 runs neck-and-neck with Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 in post-launch Geekbench tests
summary: Early Geekbench listings put the Exynos 2600 close to the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 in multi-core, but behind in single-core.

title: Xiaomi 17 Ultra hands-on: Incredible cameras, but maybe hard to get
summary: Global launch at MWC 2026, with UK pricing from £1,299. US availability was not confirmed.

title: Samsung Galaxy S26 with Exynos 2600 shows many disadvantages compared to Snapdragon
summary: Tests of European Exynos units found the S26 and S26+ slower than their US Snapdragon counterparts in several workloads, and drawing more power.

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8: Release Date, Features & Specs
summary: Samsung's guide to the Z Fold8, unveiled at Galaxy Unpacked on 22 July 2026, with a wider 4:3 main display and 5.5-inch cover screen.

title: Google Pixel 11 Pro series debuts with Tensor G6, new cameras and Qi2.2 charging
author: Anil Ganti
summary: Pixel 11 Pro ($1,099) and Pro XL ($1,299) announced with Tensor G6, 3,600-nit displays, Qi2.2 magnetic charging and seven years of updates.

title: One UI 9 Beta 6 arrives early for Galaxy S26 series with four impressive upgrades
summary: The sixth One UI 9 (Android 17) beta reached the Galaxy S26 series ahead of schedule.

title: Samsung Announces One UI 9 Beta Feature Update for Galaxy S26 series
summary: Samsung brought features from its latest foldables to One UI 9 beta testers on the Galaxy S26 series, rolling out from 28 August.

title: Galaxy S26 Ultra Gets a Surprise One UI 9 Beta Hotfix
summary: An Ultra-only hotfix for the One UI 9 beta while the stable release is still pending.

title: Samsung confirms stable Galaxy S26 One UI 9 update is coming soon
summary: Samsung says the stable One UI 9 (Android 17) release for the S26 series is coming soon, without a firm date.

title: Apple debuts iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max
summary: A20 Pro on a 2 nm process, a variable-aperture 48 MP main camera, up to 45 hours of video playback on the Pro Max, from $1,299. Available from 18 September.

title: iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max Benchmarks Reveal Speed of A20 Pro Chip
summary: Pre-release Geekbench results suggest roughly 20–28% CPU gains and a much faster GPU than the A19 Pro. They come from prototypes, so treat them as provisional.

title: Wider One UI 9 rollout starts for the Galaxy S26 series
author: Abhijeet Mishra
summary: The stable One UI 9 (Android 17) update, first released in South Korea on 16 September, is now reaching other countries, starting with US carrier models. Other regions are expected over the coming days or weeks.

title: Samsung hikes Galaxy S26 series price in India
author: Abid Iqbal Shaik
summary: A leaked retailer notice shows Indian prices of the S26, S26+ and S26 Ultra rising by INR 15,000 to 25,000 from 23 September; Samsung gave no reason, and SamMobile suspects memory chip costs. India only: Malaysian prices on this site are unchanged.

title: Motorola's new Signature 27 is among the first smartphone to use the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 processor
author: Lawrence Bonk
summary: Motorola's new flagship pairs the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 with a 50 MP main camera, a telephoto upgraded to 200 MP, Bang & Olufsen speakers and seven years of Android upgrades. Price, display details and a release date were not announced.

title: Apple confirms iPhone 18 Pro Max AT&T cellular issues, affected devices require hardware replacement
author: Chance Miller
summary: Apple confirmed that some iPhone 18 Pro Max units on AT&T in the US lose cellular service and show SOS. iOS 27.0.1 and a carrier settings update prevent it on phones not yet affected; a phone that has already lost service needs a hardware replacement through Apple or AT&T. The iPhone 18 Pro, which uses Apple's own modem, is not affected.

title: AT&T and Apple Just Took Steps Toward Fixing iPhone 18 Pro Max Issue
author: Joe Rossignol
summary: Apple released AT&T carrier settings 72.1 and now requires iOS 27.0.1 when setting up the phone; AT&T said it is working with Apple. The update was described as a mitigation rather than a complete fix, and some users reported it turns off 5G Standalone.

title: iPhone 18 Pro Owners Complain of Speaker Crackling or Popping
author: Juli Clover
summary: Some owners on the MacRumors forums and Reddit hear crackling, popping or clicking from the earpiece speaker, constantly or during actions such as scrolling, notifications or calls. Apple had not commented; iOS 27.0.1 did not address it, and some replacement units showed it too. The cause, software or hardware, is not known.

title: iFixit teardown of the new AirPods 5 reveals first real repairability improvement
author: Marcus Mendes
summary: iFixit gave the AirPods 5 a repairability score of 2 out of 10, the first AirPods above zero: the earbud batteries can be replaced by a skilled repairer without destroying the earbud (left and right are not interchangeable). The rest of each earbud is still glued, and the charging case still can't be repaired.

title: Honor 600S 5G Malaysia: Snapdragon 4 Gen 4, 50MP camera and 8,100mAh battery, priced at RM1,299
summary: On sale in Malaysia from 14 October at RM1,299 (256 GB), with a launch bundle of an RM100 rebate and a second year of warranty. It uses the entry-level Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 with 4 GB of RAM (the advertised 12 GB counts 8 GB of virtual RAM), a 6.87-inch HD+ screen, an 8,100 mAh battery with 45 W charging, IP68/IP69/IP69K ratings and a 2.5 m drop claim.

title: Oppo Find X10 Series launching in Malaysia on 22 October, pre-order promo now live
summary: The Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max launch in Malaysia on 22 October; Malaysian prices were not yet announced. An RM200 Deal Pack (8 to 22 October) is credited back when the phone is paid for between 22 and 29 October, but does not guarantee stock. Malaysian versions: Find X10 with 12 GB RAM and 256 or 512 GB; Find X10 Pro Max with 16 GB RAM and 512 GB.

title: HONOR X9e Pro goes through Military Bootcamp and survives ahead of Malaysia release
summary: HONOR Malaysia staged its own durability demonstrations (drops, mud, paint impacts, five minutes underwater) before the 9 October Malaysian release from RM1,899. These are the maker's demonstrations, not independent tests; HONOR claims drop resistance up to 3 m and IP68, IP69 and IP69K ratings.

title: Apple rolls out AT&T carrier update for iPhone 18 Pro Max on iOS 27.2 beta
author: Marcus Mendes
summary: After last week's fix for iOS 27.0 (carrier settings 72.1), Apple released carrier settings 72.0.3 for iPhone 18 Pro Max owners on AT&T who run the iOS 27.2 beta. Only the 18 Pro Max, which uses a Qualcomm modem in the US, is affected; phones that already lost service still need a hardware replacement.

title: Galaxy S26 series gets October 2026 security update
author: Abid Iqbal Shaik
summary: The first update after One UI 9.0 brings the October 2026 security patch (62 fixes) to the Galaxy S26, S26+ and S26 Ultra, starting in Canada and the US with more countries to follow. No date has been given for One UI 9.5.

title: Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 Score 4/10 for Repairability
summary: iFixit scored both watches 4 out of 10 for repairability. The Series 12 gains a pull tab for its battery adhesive and drops a fiddly connector, but the battery still sits behind the display; the Ultra 4 is unchanged. Battery capacities rose to 2.444 Wh (Ultra 4) and 1.461 Wh (46 mm Series 12). iFixit gave the Pixel Watch 5 a 9 out of 10.

title: Pixel 11 series still not on Android 17 QPR1 with October update
author: Abner Li
summary: Older Pixels received Android 17 QPR1 in September, but the Pixel 11 series' October update keeps it on the base Android 17 release. The update does fix an on-screen keyboard that sometimes failed to appear and photos or videos saved in the wrong orientation.

title: Nothing OS 5.0 update rolls out starting with Nothing Phone (3)
author: Srivatsan Sridhar
summary: The stable Nothing OS 5.0 (Android 17) update is rolling out in phases, starting with the Phone (3), with other Nothing and CMF phones to follow over the coming months. Nothing lists more than 80 changes, including a redesigned home screen and lock-screen clock and new on-device AI tools.

title: iPhone Duo Will Have Day-One iOS 27.1 Update
summary: The iPhone Duo runs iOS 27.1, a version only for the foldable, and Apple has already released a newer build, so buyers will install an update during setup. Pre-orders open on 16 October and the phone goes on sale on 23 October.

title: Galaxy A57 owners may want to avoid upgrading to One UI 9.0 right now
author: Mihai Matei
summary: Some Galaxy A57 owners reported that the phone failed to start normally after installing One UI 9.0. Owners found that starting once in Safe Mode and then restarting normally gets past the error; Samsung had not commented.

title: Report: Apple cuts iPhone 18 Pro production due to 'soft demand'
author: Chance Miller
summary: A Nikkei Asia report, citing unnamed supply-chain sources, says Apple cut October component orders for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max by 15 to 20% after the US$100 price rise softened demand. Apple has not confirmed it; its next quarterly results are due on 2 November.

title: 苹果 iPhone 18 Pro/Max 测试：无可变电压供电充电器也能接近满速快充
summary: IT Home reports LTT Labs' charging test: a USB PD charger without AVS (UGREEN Nexode 140W) charged the iPhone 18 Pro as fast as Apple's 40W Dynamic adapter. On the 18 Pro Max, Apple's adapter peaked near 50 W and filled it in 82 minutes, against 84 minutes with the UGREEN charger, which stayed below 50 W.

title: What Samsung fans are saying about Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra battery life
summary: Owner reports on Reddit (not tests): upgraders from older Folds describe 8 to 9 hours of screen-on time from the Fold 8 Ultra's 5,000 mAh battery, the first capacity rise since the Fold 3, and similar results from the Fold 8's 4,800 mAh. One owner coming from an iPhone 17 Pro Max was less impressed, and SamMobile found it does not last as long as the Galaxy S26 Ultra.

title: iPhone Duo pre-orders mostly sold out in Malaysia, Apple Store delivery slips to January 2027
summary: Malaysian pre-orders opened at 8 pm on 16 October and most of the first stock at Apple Authorised Retailers, LazMall and Shopee Mall stores was gone within an hour; telcos had mainly the 256 GB model left. New orders on Apple's Malaysian online store showed delivery from 22 January 2027. The phone goes on sale in Malaysia on 23 October.

title: iPhone Duo's inner screen costs RM4,749 to repair: Here's why you need Apple Care+
summary: Apple's Malaysian out-of-warranty prices: inner folding screen RM4,749, outer screen RM1,799, back glass RM909, battery RM1,049, rear camera RM1,009, cover layer RM199, other damage up to RM7,119. AppleCare+ costs RM1,499 for two years and cuts an inner-screen repair to RM469 (outer screen or back glass RM139); battery service is free below 80% health.

title: Didn't pre-order iPhone Duo? Don't queue at Apple Store TRX this Friday
summary: Apple's Malaysian iPhone Duo page says the phone is "currently available to buy online only", with delivery or pick-up at an Apple Store, so Apple The Exchange TRX is not expected to sell walk-in units on 23 October. Malaysia is in the first wave of more than 70 countries; another 28 follow from 30 October.

title: Apple Reveals iPhone Duo's Battery Capacity
summary: Apple's EU energy label gives the iPhone Duo a total battery capacity of 4,883 mAh, matching an earlier leak of two cells (2,962 and 1,921 mAh). The Duo is eSIM-only everywhere, so the figure should apply worldwide. For comparison, iFixit measured 4,288 mAh in the eSIM-only iPhone 18 Pro and 5,567 mAh in the eSIM-only 18 Pro Max.

title: Apple Now Sells DIY Repair Parts for iPhone 18 Pro and Two New Macs
author: Joe Rossignol
summary: Apple's Self Service Repair store now sells parts, tools and repair manuals for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, in the US, Canada and Europe; Malaysia was not among the regions listed.

title: New Galaxy S25 update brings October 2026 security patch
author: Abid Iqbal Shaik
summary: The first update for the Galaxy S25, S25+ and S25 Ultra after One UI 9.0 adds the October 2026 security patch (62 fixes), starting in South Korea with other countries to follow. The S25 series is promised seven years of major OS and security updates.

title: Galaxy S23 stable One UI 9.0 (Android 17) update goes global
author: Abid Iqbal Shaik
summary: Stable One UI 9.0 (Android 17) is reaching the Galaxy S23 series outside South Korea, starting in Europe with phones in the beta programme and then other users and countries. It adds more Quick Panel customisation, DeX and Notes improvements, accessibility upgrades, a location privacy indicator and new AI features.

title: One UI 9 brings AirDrop file sharing to the Galaxy A56
author: Asif Iqbal Shaik
summary: With One UI 9.0, Quick Share on the Galaxy A56 can send and receive files with iPhones, iPads and Macs: update Quick Share from the Galaxy Store, then turn on "Share with Apple devices" (Settings > Connected devices > Quick Share). The Apple device must have AirDrop set to Everyone.

title: Xiaomi 18 Pro gears up for global debut with rumored battery cuts and €1,449 starting price
author: Ben Schoon
summary: A leak reported by YTechB (not confirmed by Xiaomi) puts European prices at €1,449 for the 18 Pro (256 GB) and €1,849 for the 18 Pro Max (512 GB). The EU's energy labels list smaller batteries than the Chinese models: 6,000 mAh instead of 7,000 for the Pro and 7,050 instead of 8,500 for the Pro Max, with the Pro limited to 90 W charging in the EU. Malaysian versions have not been detailed.

title: Galaxy S26 Ultra is one of the 'best inventions of 2026' thanks to its Privacy Display
author: Andrew Romero
summary: TIME's "best inventions of 2026" list includes the Galaxy S26 Ultra for its Privacy Display, which can hide the whole screen or parts of it (such as PIN entry or notifications) from people beside you. 9to5Google notes it can look inconsistent in some lighting.

title: Oppo Find X10 series Malaysia: Up to triple 200MP Hasselblad cameras and 8,000mAh battery, priced from RM4,599
author: Alexander Wong
summary: Both models launched in Malaysia on 22 October with an 8,000 mAh silicon-carbon battery, 80 W wired and 50 W wireless charging and IP66/68/69. SoyaCincau lists RM4,599 for the Find X10 12 GB/256 GB, RM4,999 for 12 GB/512 GB and RM6,999 for the Pro Max 16 GB/512 GB; TechNave and Zing Gadget give RM4,999 as the Find X10's starting price, so the 256 GB price is not settled. Pre-orders ran until 29 October with a free 3D printer for the Pro Max and a free 512 GB upgrade for the Find X10.

title: OPPO Find X10 Series now in Malaysia with a triple 200MP camera system and an 8,000mAh battery, starting price at RM4,999
author: Abel Wong
summary: TechNave gives RM4,999 for the Find X10 with 12 GB RAM and 256 GB storage as the series' Malaysian starting price, which differs from SoyaCincau's table (RM4,599 for that model).

title: Vivo X500 series Malaysia: Up to 200MP ZEISS Camera, 7,800mAh battery, priced from RM4,699
author: Alexander Wong
summary: All three models are on sale in Malaysia through vivo's own store, Lazada and Shopee. Recommended prices: X500 RM4,699 (12/256 GB) and RM5,299 (12/512 GB), X500 Pro RM5,999 (12/256 GB), X500 Pro Max RM6,399 (12/256 GB) and RM6,999 (12/512 GB), and a 1 TB Photographer Kit at RM9,699. Early-bird prices until 2 November were RM300 lower for the Pro and Pro Max. Batteries: 7,500 mAh (X500), 6,510 mAh (Pro), 7,800 mAh (Pro Max), all with 90 W wired and 40 W wireless charging. TechNave reports the same starting and Pro Max prices.

title: iPhone Duo now officially in Malaysia: Queue still present at Apple Store TRX despite no walk-in stock
summary: The iPhone Duo went on sale in Malaysia on 23 October. Apple Store The Exchange TRX had display units but no walk-in stock; a new order on Apple's online store that day showed delivery in late January 2027. AppleCare+ costs RM1,499 and cuts an inner-screen repair from RM4,749 to RM469.

title: Before you buy an iPhone Duo online, watch out for this scam
summary: Kaspersky found fake stores imitating Apple that offer the iPhone Duo at a "25% launch discount" or ready stock and ask for name, phone and address (or a WhatsApp chat) before taking money. No Malay-language fake site was seen yet. With Malaysian stock scarce (from RM9,499 for 256 GB), SoyaCincau advises buying only from Apple, authorised resellers and telcos.

title: Bought an iPhone 18 Pro? This protection plan promises up to 55% buyback value next year
summary: Swap Protect 360 (RM1,099 for two years, underwritten by The Pacific Insurance) covers accidental damage, liquid damage, attended theft and an extended warranty for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max in Malaysia, and guarantees a cash buyback of up to 55% of the recommended price without having to buy another phone. Enrolment must be within 30 days of purchase; it is open until 1 April 2027.

title: Built to Go the Distance: How the Samsung Galaxy A08 Redefines Long-Term Reliability for Malaysians
summary: Samsung Malaysia: the Galaxy A08 is rated IP64 (dust and splashes, not for submersion), uses LPDDR5 RAM with up to 6 GB of extra virtual RAM, and gets up to six generations of OS upgrades and six years of security updates from its first global launch.

title: iFixit iPhone Duo Teardown Points to Possible Cause of Screen Cracks
summary: iFixit gave the iPhone Duo a provisional repairability score of 5 out of 10 (the Galaxy Z Fold8 and Pixel 11 Pro Fold got 4): the outer screen comes off intact and the batteries release with a small electrical charge, but the inner display and hinge are hard to replace. Dust reached the hinge in its test, though less than on the Fold8 or Pixel 11 Pro Fold. The reported inner-screen cracks cluster where the hinge's cable gap meets its central support; iFixit names a hinge part that may not retract as one possible cause, without a firm answer.

title: Apple responds to reports of iPhone Duo's inner display cracking
author: Chance Miller
summary: Apple says it is aware of an issue affecting the inner display of a small number of iPhone Duo units, which shows up soon after purchase. Affected owners should contact AppleCare for a replacement; AppleCare+ is not needed, and phones bought from a carrier also go to AppleCare. Some reports online were AI-generated fakes.

title: Apple Alerts Stores to iPhone Duo's Display Cracking Issue
summary: An internal memo seen by MacRumors tells Apple Stores and authorised service providers to inspect a Duo with the inner-screen problem and repair or replace it under standard procedures. Apple says there is no recall and has no public repair programme for it yet.

title: Some Galaxy S26 phones are basically paperweights while Samsung fixes a setup bug
author: Ben Schoon
summary: Some Galaxy S26 Ultra owners report being stuck at setup after a reset on One UI 9.0, with a "webpage is unavailable" error on a Samsung account page. A Samsung forum representative blamed an unstable system WebView on certain networks; switching from Wi-Fi to mobile data may get past it. A fix had not been released when reported.

title: Some Galaxy S24, S25 owners say Samsung's latest update is wrecking battery life
author: Ben Schoon
summary: Owners' reports (not widespread so far) of worse battery life, including higher idle drain, on Galaxy S24 and S25 phones after the One UI 9.0 (Android 17) update. Suggested steps: restart, force-stop misbehaving apps, or as a last resort a factory reset.

title: Galaxy A35 stable One UI 9.0 (Android 17) update goes global
author: Abid Iqbal Shaik
summary: After South Korea, stable One UI 9.0 is rolling out to the Galaxy A35 worldwide, with India among the first countries (firmware A356EXXUBEZJ2, for beta and non-beta users). It adds Quick panel customisation, a Warranty and care section, privacy indicators and redesigned Health, Accessibility and lock-screen clock.

title: Stable One UI 9 update rolling out to the Galaxy A55 more widely
author: Asif Iqbal Shaik
summary: Stable One UI 9.0 (Android 17) for the Galaxy A55 is spreading beyond South Korea, first to beta users in India (firmware A556EXXUIEZJ1, over 300 MB), with Europe and the US expected next.

title: Samsung updates Galaxy A57 with October 2026 security patch
author: Abid Iqbal Shaik
summary: A 370 MB update (firmware A5763XXS63ZJ2) brings the October 2026 security patch (62 fixes) to the Galaxy A57, starting in Europe and the Middle East; the earlier One UI 9.0 update had shipped with September's patch. The report does not mention the start-up problem some A57 owners reported after One UI 9.0.

title: Apple Released iOS 27.1 for iPhone Duo Only
summary: iOS 27.1 is only for the iPhone Duo: it ships preinstalled and a newer 27.1 build (bug fixes, no security fixes) installs during setup. Other iPhones skip to iOS 27.2, which the Duo can also install, expected about a week later.

title: 5999元起 小米18 Pro系列上市后门店客流火爆：部分版本供不应求
summary: Xiaomi's president Lu Weibing said on 24 September that the Xiaomi 18 Pro series (18 Pro, 18 Pro Max and a transparent edition) had gone on sale in China from CNY 5,999, with busy Xiaomi stores and some versions short of stock. Xiaomi has said a global version will follow this year; no Malaysian price or date yet.

title: Motorola is officially launching its Signature 27 flagship next week
author: Ben Schoon
summary: Motorola confirmed that the Signature 27, its Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 flagship, will officially launch on 5 November 2026, including in the US. Full specifications and pricing are expected then; it is not yet clear whether it goes on sale the same day. No Malaysian launch has been announced.

title: iPad Mini 2026 Malaysia: Larger 8.5" OLED, A20 Pro and first iPad with water resistance, priced from RM2,999
summary: Malaysian pre-orders from 29 October 2026 and sales from 6 November: Wi-Fi RM2,999 (128 GB), RM3,399 (256 GB), RM4,299 (512 GB); Wi-Fi + 5G RM3,699, RM4,099 and RM4,999. RM800 more than the A17 Pro model's starting price. 8.5-inch OLED (still 60 Hz), A20 Pro, IP67, 5.4 mm and 255 g.

title: Vivo X Fold6 Quietly Launches In Malaysia
summary: The X Fold6 went on sale on vivo Malaysia's online store without a launch event, in one 12 GB / 512 GB version at RM8,299 (Zing Gadget gives RM8,699 as the listed price before the offer).

title: OPPO Pad Mini Arrives In Malaysia With 8,000mAh Battery
summary: Launched alongside the Find X10 series, the OPPO Pad Mini (Matte Display Edition in Malaysia) costs RM3,699 for 8 GB / 256 GB, with an RM200 pre-order rebate.

title: Huawei Watch 6 series and FreeBuds SE 5 Max Malaysia pre-orders now open
summary: Pre-orders for the Watch 6 and Watch 6 Pro run until 2 November 2026 with gifts worth up to RM993; prices are announced at the 3 November launch. The FreeBuds SE 5 Max cost RM249 (RM159 with an early-bird rebate).

title: CMF Buds Neo and Clip Pro Malaysia: up to 52 hours battery life and hybrid ANC from RM129
summary: Both on sale in Malaysia from 19 October 2026: Buds Neo RM129 (35 dB hybrid ANC, 52 h with the case) and the open-ear Clip Pro RM359 (LDAC, 32.5 h with the case).

title: iQoo 16 launch this November: Will this be Malaysia's first Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 smartphone?
summary: iQOO confirmed the iQOO 16 for Malaysia in November 2026 in four configurations (12/256 GB to 16 GB/1 TB); no price yet. 6.85-inch 2K 165 Hz Samsung display, 8,400 mAh battery with 100 W wired and 40 W wireless charging, IP68/IP69.

title: Huawei Watch GT 7 Series Goes Official In Malaysia
summary: The Watch GT 7 costs RM1,199 and the GT 7 Pro RM1,499 in Malaysia, each RM100 less with a launch rebate that ran until 31 October 2026.

title: REDMAGIC Astra 2 Malaysia Launch - Liquid-Cooled Gaming Tablet, starting at RM3,399
summary: The official SIRIM-certified Astra 2 is sold through ZTE and nubia stores at RM3,399 (12 GB / 256 GB) and RM3,999 (16 GB / 512 GB).

title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 series now in Malaysia, student pricing starts from RM3999.20
summary: On sale in Malaysia from 7 October 2026 in one 12 GB / 256 GB configuration. Students get 20% off; until 8 November everyone gets RM400 (Tab S12+) or RM500 (Ultra) off with SPayLater or selected bank cards.
